description:
Every adventure feels a little more magical with the Huffy 6V Princess Bubble Quad. A built-in bubble maker fills the air with floating bubbles as toddlers ride, turning backyard playtime, driveway cruises, and sidewalk adventures into unforgettable moments filled with smiles and imagination.
Designed for riders ages 1.5 to 3, this charming quad combines easy-to-use electric fun with princess-inspired style. The sparkling pink finish, glittery accents, and adorable character details create a fairytale look that makes every ride feel special from the very first push of the pedal.
A wide, stable base and low-profile seat help young riders feel comfortable and confident as they explore. The gentle 1.5 MPH drive speed and simple foot pedal operation make it easy to learn, while the included charger and bubble solution mean the fun can begin right away.
